music_hubs_layout_improvise_blurb: Jwe nenpòt sa sou gwoup la. Tande pran an jan ou te jwe l, epi apre sa ajiste sou griy lan.
music_hubs_layout_lead_sheets_blurb: Melodi a nan men dwat, rasin, shell oswa akò nan men goch, apati yon lead sheet oswa pwòp pati ou.

music_hubs_ref_vocabulary_intro: Uit fanmi jazz yo, tout sou C, ak ekstansyon chak pran.
music_hubs_ref_chord_scales_intro: Ki gam ki sonnen byen sou chak fanmi akò. Aprann prensipal la an premye. Montre mete l sou klavye ki anwo a.
music_hubs_ref_show_scale: Montre C {label} pou {chord} sou klavye a

music_hubs_ref_recipe_rootless_b_use: Sèvi avè l lè nòt melodi a se kent lan. Men goch la pran rasin lan.
